blocks.explanation:
Do angles hain; har ek ka ek ratio aur quadrant diya hai.
Humein \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) nikalna hai.
Plan: pehle \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\) ke baqi ratios sahi signs ke saath, phir formula. Sign ki ek ghalti poora jawab bigaad deti hai, is liye quadrant ko har qadam par yaad rakhein.
Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: "All, Sin, Tan, Cos", yani quadrant I mein sab positive, II mein sirf sin, III mein sirf tan, IV mein sirf cos.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin\alpha = -\frac{8}{17}\) (\(\alpha\) quadrant IV mein), \(\cos\beta = -\frac{4}{5}\) (\(\beta\) quadrant III mein).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\).
Tareeqa: \[\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
Pehle \(\cos\alpha\) aur \(\sin\beta\) nikalne hain; quadrant hi batayega ke sign plus hoga ya minus.

Missing ratios nikalein
\[\cos\alpha = +\sqrt{1 - \dfrac{64}{289}} = \dfrac{15}{17}\]
\[\sin\beta = -\sqrt{1 - \dfrac{16}{25}} = -\dfrac{3}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\) se square nikla; \(289 - 64 = 225\) aur \(\sqrt{225} = 15\). Quadrant IV mein sirf cosine (aur sec) positive hota hai, is liye \(\cos\alpha\) positive. Quadrant III mein sirf tan (aur cot) positive, is liye \(\sin\beta\) negative.

Values rakhein
\[= \left(-\dfrac{8}{17}\right)\left(-\dfrac{4}{5}\right) + \dfrac{15}{17}\left(-\dfrac{3}{5}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{32}{85} - \dfrac{45}{85} = -\dfrac{13}{85}\]
Kyun: Pehle product mein do negatives, to positive \(\frac{32}{85}\). Doosre mein ek positive aur ek negative, to negative \(\frac{45}{85}\). Denominator \(17 \times 5 = 85\).
Dhyan dein: Har negative value ko bracket mein likhein; signs ki ghalti yahin hoti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[13^2 + 84^2 = 169 + 7056 = 7225 = 85^2\]
Kyun: \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) = -\frac{84}{85}\) (part ii) ke saath \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\) poora hota hai \(\checkmark\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key part (i) ke liye \(-\frac{56}{65}\) deta hai. Yeh kitab ke diye hue data se nahi milta: \(\sin\alpha = -\frac{8}{17}\), \(\cos\alpha = \frac{15}{17}\), \(\sin\beta = -\frac{3}{5}\), \(\cos\beta = -\frac{4}{5}\) se har jawab ka denominator 85 aata hai, 65 nahi. Sahi jawab \(-\dfrac{13}{85}\) hai.

blocks.explanation:
Do angles hain; har ek ka ek ratio aur quadrant diya hai.
Humein \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) nikalna hai.
Plan: pehle \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\) ke baqi ratios sahi signs ke saath, phir formula. Sign ki ek ghalti poora jawab bigaad deti hai, is liye quadrant ko har qadam par yaad rakhein.
Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: "All, Sin, Tan, Cos", yani quadrant I mein sab positive, II mein sirf sin, III mein sirf tan, IV mein sirf cos.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin\alpha = -\frac{8}{17}\) (\(\alpha\) quadrant IV mein), \(\cos\beta = -\frac{4}{5}\) (\(\beta\) quadrant III mein).
Humein find karna hai: \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\).
Tareeqa: \[\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{\sin(\alpha + \beta)}{\cos(\alpha + \beta)}\]
Yahan \(\alpha + \beta\) ka sine aur cosine chahiye, jo parts (i) aur (ii) mein nikalte hain. Tangent ka apna formula bhi lag sakta hai, lekin sine aur cosine pehle se hon to divide karna sab se tez hai.
Pehle \(\cos\alpha\) aur \(\sin\beta\) nikalne hain; quadrant hi batayega ke sign plus hoga ya minus.

Missing ratios nikalein
\[\cos\alpha = +\sqrt{1 - \dfrac{64}{289}} = \dfrac{15}{17}\]
\[\sin\beta = -\sqrt{1 - \dfrac{16}{25}} = -\dfrac{3}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\) se square nikla; \(289 - 64 = 225\) aur \(\sqrt{225} = 15\). Quadrant IV mein sirf cosine (aur sec) positive hota hai, is liye \(\cos\alpha\) positive. Quadrant III mein sirf tan (aur cot) positive, is liye \(\sin\beta\) negative.

\(\alpha + \beta\) ka sine aur cosine
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{32}{85} - \dfrac{45}{85} = -\dfrac{13}{85}\]
\[\cos(\alpha + \beta) = -\dfrac{60}{85} - \dfrac{24}{85} = -\dfrac{84}{85}\]
Kyun: Yeh wahi hisaab hai jo parts (i) aur (ii) mein kiya.
@@Divide karein
\[\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{-13/85}{-84/85} = \dfrac{13}{84}\]
Kyun: Tangent = sine / cosine. Dono ka denominator 85 cancel ho gaya, aur negative ko negative se divide karne par positive aata hai. Tan formula \(\frac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\) se bhi yahi aata hai (\(\tan\alpha = -\frac{8}{15}\), \(\tan\beta = \frac{3}{4}\)).

Tasdeeq
\[\tan\alpha = -\dfrac{8}{15},\ \tan\beta = \dfrac{3}{4}\]
\[\dfrac{-\frac{8}{15} + \frac{3}{4}}{1 + \frac{8}{15}\cdot\frac{3}{4}} \]
\[= \dfrac{13/60}{84/60} = \dfrac{13}{84} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tan ke apne formula se bhi wahi jawab.

blocks.prompt: 9 (vii) [printed without a label] If \(\sin\alpha = -\dfrac{8}{17}\) and \(\cos\beta = -\dfrac{4}{5}\) where \(\dfrac{3\pi}{2} < \alpha < 2\pi\) and \(\pi < \beta < \dfrac{3\pi}{2}\). In which quadrants do the terminal sides of the angles of measures \((\alpha + \beta)\) and \((\alpha - \beta)\) lie?
blocks.explanation:
Kisi angle ka quadrant us ke sine aur cosine ke signs se pata chalta hai.
\(\alpha + \beta\) aur \(\alpha - \beta\) ke sine aur cosine hum parts (i), (ii), (iv), (v) mein nikal chuke hain.
Plan: signs dekho aur quadrant chart se milao.
steps:
Diya gaya hai (pichle parts se): \(\sin(\alpha + \beta) = -\frac{13}{85}\), \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) = -\frac{84}{85}\), \(\sin(\alpha - \beta) = \frac{77}{85}\), \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = -\frac{36}{85}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\alpha + \beta\) aur \(\alpha - \beta\) ke terminal sides (aakhri baazu) kis quadrant mein hain.
Tareeqa: sine quadrant I aur II mein positive hota hai; cosine quadrant I aur IV mein. Dono signs mila kar ek hi quadrant bachta hai.

\(\alpha + \beta\) ka quadrant
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta) < 0,\quad \cos(\alpha + \beta) < 0\]
\[\Rightarrow \text{quadrant III}\]
Kyun: Sine negative ka matlab III ya IV; cosine negative ka matlab II ya III. Dono mein mushtarik sirf III hai.

\(\alpha - \beta\) ka quadrant
\[\sin(\alpha - \beta) > 0,\quad \cos(\alpha - \beta) < 0\]
\[\Rightarrow \text{quadrant II}\]
Kyun: Sine positive: I ya II; cosine negative: II ya III. Mushtarik sirf II.
Dhyan dein: Sirf ek ratio dekh kar quadrant tay na karein; hamesha do ratios ke signs milayen.

Tasdeeq, angles ke size se
\[270^{\circ} < \alpha < 360^{\circ},\quad 180^{\circ} < \beta < 270^{\circ}\]
\[\alpha \approx 331.9^{\circ},\ \beta \approx 216.9^{\circ}\]
\[\alpha + \beta \approx 548.8^{\circ} \equiv 188.8^{\circ}\ (\text{III})\]
\[\alpha - \beta \approx 115.1^{\circ}\ (\text{II}) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Calculator se angles nikal kar dekha; \(360^{\circ}\) ghatane se terminal side nahi badalta. Dono quadrants mil gaye.
blocks.final_answer: \(\alpha + \beta\) quadrant III mein hai aur \(\alpha - \beta\) quadrant II mein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key kehta hai ke \(\alpha + \beta\) aur \(\alpha - \beta\) quadrants III aur I mein hain. Kitab ke data se \(\sin(\alpha - \beta) = \frac{77}{85}\) positive aur \(\cos(\alpha - \beta) = -\frac{36}{85}\) negative hai, is liye \(\alpha - \beta\) quadrant II mein hai, I mein nahi. \(\alpha + \beta\) quadrant III mein hi hai.
